title: Refund
body: Hello, this app is very nice and helpful for other people. I saw this app’s advertisement everywhere on social media platforms so I thought it might be effective for me also but as soon as I subscribed in the introduction of the app, the part where I needed to subscribe didn’t mention that the money would be deducted as the same day as I subscribed. It only mentions that I have a 7-day free trial and a subscription for 12 months that cost almost 1,500 pesos. As far as my understanding 7-day free trial means that I don’t need to pay anything even if I have the subscription connected to my bank account during those 7 days which also means that the subscription payment will only start AFTER the 7-day free trial. I can’t blame the people complaining about this situation as same as me because not all people have the capability to lose that kind of money specifically to college students who only seek help that is convenient for them but turned out to be a Low-key scam. So please do something about your introductions on the app to prevent any misleading information. Be considerate and smart enough to program a decent app where people don’t have to lose huge amounts of money on something that is not useful for them. P. S I need the refund since it is my college savings. I hope you read this comment, kindly asking. Please don’t do something that will make people report or write bad comments about your app. Thank you 🙂

title: Promising
body:
I like the aesthetic and overall functionality of the app however I do feel that there are many things that could be improved. Will share some of my insights:

1) How do I set certain tasks to a fixed time? The tasks are right now jumbled all together under “Any time of the day.”
2) Widgets should be customisable and not randomized.
3) Healthy recipes and maybe a food/calorie intake tracker would be a cool addition to the app instead of just listing literal healthy foods.
4) The routine layout I would say just needs to be more organized and customisable. 

Hope you could continue to make improvements because it has a lot of potential and has so far been helpful with my routine. 🙏🏻

title: Great, but needs some improvement
body:
The aesthetic and idea are great, as are some aspects of the app. But for now not worth the price:

- I had to restart the app to update the time and sometimes tasks. 
- The widgets are not customisable—it chooses random items from your checklist. And you can’t choose a specific list for it either. - So you can’t have multiple widgets with different checklists. 
- So much scrolling to find the right emoji. It takes so much effort to duplicate the same task at different times you have to input a new one if you want your task manually. 
- And this is probably just me, but some meditation voices are annoying, hopefully an option to choose a voice.
